metadata.title: Soul and Blues Album Cover Layout

retrievalProfile.description: A duotone portrait layout featuring a high-contrast foreground subject against a faded, large-scale background ghost image, framed by black horizontal bars with wide-tracked serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-layered composition consisting of a solid black header and footer containing white text, a large faded background portrait in a magenta duotone, and a sharp, high-contrast foreground subject interacting with an object.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject anchored to the bottom-right third
Faded background face occupying the upper-left two-thirds
Horizontal black bands framing the central image
Monochromatic magenta color cast across the central photographic area
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white foreground subject against a tinted background
Wide letter-spacing in the display typography
Double-exposure effect with varying opacity levels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Foreground subject is small-scale, positioned horizontally across the lower half; background subject is large-scale, cropped to the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black clothing of the foreground figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, move to the large background face, then down to the foreground figure and bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The magenta-tinted mid-ground acts as negative space between the two portraits.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Magenta/Purple duotone for the photographic mid-section.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the header and footer bars.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the typography and highlights in the foreground subject.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black bars; low saturation magenta tinting.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif with high contrast and sharp terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform typeface family used for both header and footer with varying scale and tracking.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the flared terminals and elegant stroke contrast.
Captures the classical Roman uppercase authority.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a duotone magenta image with a large, low-opacity face in the background and a high-contrast, sharp foreground figure lying down with a guitar. Add solid black bars at the very top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place white, wide-tracked, high-contrast serif text in all-caps centered within the top and bottom black bars.

verificationChecks: Is the background face low opacity and magenta-tinted?
Are the top and bottom bars solid black?
Is the text white and widely tracked?
Is the foreground subject high contrast?

adjustableVariables: Height of the black header/footer bars

mustAchieve: Distinct separation between foreground and background layers

postGenerationChecks: Text is perfectly centered in black bars
Foreground subject does not overlap the black bars
Background face is recognizable but ethereal
Color palette is strictly limited to black, white, and magenta tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered duotone portrait + black letterbox bars + wide-tracked Roman serif typography.
